content: Henot Yunus nobi moha narazoil edde guššaoil.

Tãi Mabudor hãse munazat gori hoil: Ya Mabud, in no neki ãi ãr nizor dešot takite hoilamde? Hetollana ãi toratori foilabar Toršišot daizaiboilla gilamgoide; haron ãi zaintam, tũi rahamoti edde doyaban Allah, aste gušša oya edde oṭol muhabbote mohan, ar šasti mafgoridite toiyar.
Hetolla ehon, o Mabud, foriyadgorir ãttu ãr foran horifelo kiyollahoile ãi zinda takattuwaro moron bala oibo.
Mabude hodde: Tui gušša oiosde ki bala oil?
Hẽtte Yunus nobi šohoror baire fuke ek zagat boiṛa aššil. Heṛe tãi nizolla ekkan zuguṛi baša banai heṛe tole sabat boiaššil, šohoror ki doša o hin saibar ofekkat.
Mabud Allah uggwa beronggas fuṛail; ar he gasore ḍõr gori Yunus nobir uwore annil, zene tãir matar uwore gasor sába o, edde tãittu biyaram no lage. Ar Yunus nobi he beronggasswa loi beši kuši oil.
Kintu tarfordin beil uṛibar age Allah uggwa log defeṛail, he loge oi beronggassware haṛifelail, he harone beronggasswa fuaigilgoi.

Bade zehon beil uṛil, Allaye fukali gorom bataš defeṛail, henot Yunus nobir matat endilla ze roid lagil, tãi beši durbol oi gilgoi, edde tãi moribolla foriyadgoijjil, hoil: Ãi zinda takattu aro moron bala oibo.
Tehon Allah Yunus nobire hodde: Oi beronggas šomonde rag gorilide iyan ki soiyi oil? Tãi hoil: Oy, iyanor haron ase, ãi guššaye moitto sai.
Allaye hodde: Tui ei beronggasolla honokissu no goros, ibare barai o no tulos, iba ek raite fuṭṭye edde ek raite mori gilgoi, tarfore o ei beronggasolla doya lager.
Toile ãi ki Ninevir ei moha šohoror uwore doya no goijjum? Heṛe endilla ek lak kuri hazarottu aro beši manuš ase, zara ḍen hat bam hat forokgori no zane; aro bout beši zanuwar okkol ase.
